title: K-means assignment and update
summary: The k-means assignment and update steps with a tie rule and an empty cluster rule, and a full run until the assignments stop changing.

mutants.empty_cluster_nan: Takes the mean of an empty cluster, so its centroid becomes NaN.
mutants.empty_cluster_zero: Starts the new centroids from zeros, so an empty cluster moves to the origin.
mutants.manhattan_distance: Assigns by the sum of absolute differences and not by the squared Euclidean distance.
mutants.one_iteration_too_many: Returns one more than the number of update steps.
mutants.tie_highest_index: Sends a tied point to the highest index and not the lowest.
mutants.update_writes_input: Writes the new centroids into the caller's centroid array.
